mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression and carisoprodol is metabolized to meprobamate, which may have additive depressant effects; metronidazole may inhibit carisoprodol metabolism via CYP450 pathways.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression (dizziness, drowsiness, impaired coordination); counsel patient to avoid alcohol and advise caution with activities requiring alertness; consider dose adjustment if necessary.
